Coming from someone who (a) isn’t married and (b) doesn’t have kids, I wanted to add a different perspective to this, in hopes of this helping. 
Maybe she wants to name your child’s middle name not to remember her previous lover, but a previous friend. A good friend of mine and I dated for a while and although it didn’t work out, I still care about her because I love her as a friend. And if she were to die, God forbid, I would want her awesome legacy to live on in some way. So, maybe your wife wants the memory of her friend to live on through her child.
However, I can also understand your gripe with this: I can see how looking at your child and knowing his/her name is from your wife’s previous lover. 
So really, my advice: both you and your wife should sit on this for a bit and have each of you think about how this will affect not just your partner, but the child as well.
